evidence: Separate Spring Boot applications: auth-service, patient-service, appointment-service, hospital-gateway, EurekaServer. Each has its own application class and port.
Gateway route configuration maps /auth/**, /api/patients/** and /api/appointments/** to service IDs; JwtAuthenticationFilter implements GlobalFilter.
Eureka server uses @EnableEurekaServer; services use @EnableDiscoveryClient; routes use lb:// service identifiers.
Controllers, Entity classes, Repository interfaces, and Config/Service packages are separated.
PatientRepo, AppointmentRepo, and UserRepo extend JpaRepository and abstract persistence operations.
Spring injects repository, JWT service, encoder, RestTemplate and WebClient builder. Mostly field injection via @Autowired.
Spring @Component/@Service/@Configuration beans are singleton-scoped by default.
RestTemplate and WebClient client calls refactored into interchangeable strategy implementations.
Event-driven notification listener for appointment creation and status changes.
Resilience4j @CircuitBreaker fallback integration for inter-service communication.
